_about: The optional data bundles this Kepler accepts. Ships inside the wheel: an
installed Kepler fetches exactly these bytes and rejects anything else, so a
wheel cannot pair itself with a bundle built for another release.
Each archive is content-addressed and published as an asset of this
repository's standing 'data' GitHub release (phase C8 of
`python -m tools.mcp.bundles NAME SOURCE OUT`; builds are deterministic.

optical.description: The bundled optical frame library (data/optical/): photometry targets, frame listings, the NGC 5128 end-to-end calibration.

isochrones.description: The Girardi isochrone grid the HR-diagram isochrone fit reads (KEPLER_ISOCHRONE_DIR).
